summary.text: Dell Kerbs has served House District 26 in the Oklahoma House of Representatives since 2016. He currently chairs the House Education Oversight Committee.

paragraphs.text: Kerbs was born in Ponca City and raised in Dewey, and has called Shawnee home for many years.
He and his family own and operate a small restaurant in Shawnee.
He is a member of the Shawnee Historic Alliance, the Downtown Merchant Group and Shawnee's Planning Commission, and of the Emergency Operations Center.
For 21 years he has served as president of Safe Events for Families, which provides festivals and entertainment for the local community.
